Safavi warns of expanded battlefield; 98th Division HQ assumes West Bank command.

sections.executive_summary: Yemeni Houthi missiles targeted Saudi Aramco as IDF conducted multiple counterterrorism operations killing Hamas financial manager Abu Aluan and commander Awad holding 7 hostages. A car-ramming at Maccabim Junction wounded the son of Israel's US ambassador critically while the 98th Division HQ assumed West Bank command. Iran's Gen. Safavi warned any US-Israeli attack could expand beyond the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz.

sections.threat_assessment: Gen. Safavi's warning that any US-Israeli attack could expand beyond the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz signals Iran's explicit red-line articulation. The killing of IRGC Gen. Zarifi in Sistan-Baluchestan by Baloch separatists adds internal instability dimension to Iran's security posture. CIA alerts about potential Russian cruise missile launches from Mediterranean ships targeting European elections indicate a multi-front threat environment. Houthi strikes on Aramco demonstrate continued Yemeni capability to project power into Gulf states.
sections.regional_response: Israel's 98th Division HQ assumption of West Bank command signals a structural military escalation in response to recent terror attacks. IDF targeted Hamas financial infrastructure killing Abu Aluan and commander Awad holding 7 hostages, indicating continued offensive operations despite ceasefire framework. Hezbollah's reaffirmation of 15-month ceasefire compliance contrasts with Israeli government inaction on Lebanese territory. France Italy Spain receiving CIA warnings suggests coordinated Western intelligence response to Russian hybrid threats.
sections.intelligence_notes: The convergence of Houthi missile activity, Hamas leadership eliminations, and West Bank security restructuring indicates a multi-front operational tempo. The car-ramming targeting ambassador's son represents potential escalation in symbolic attacks against diplomatic figures. Iran's internal Baloch separatist activity combined with external US Senate vote speculation creates a complex threat matrix. Starlink station fire in Poland and Bundeswehr drone incidents near Arrow 3 delivery suggest hybrid warfare tactics targeting critical infrastructure.
